findings.title: Normal Taiwan Traditional Chinese evidence and comparison content still exposes internal English terms
findings.head: 3481dac48ec60e943b5d669f0f7ff0453756ab3d
steps: Use a new trusted synthetic Mei session on the repaired production build.
Open the canonical Xinyi comparison and imported-stone evidence.
Follow an authorized historical actual-cost source and inspect its exact locator in zh-TW.
Follow the current Xinyi forecast source and inspect its exact locator in zh-TW.
Repeat the source panel at desktop, tablet, mobile and narrow widths; internal English record types remain visible.
Close the evidence panel and inspect the normal Chinese comparison summary: the comparison-policy field exposes CPI-SIM-1.0.
Scroll to ordinary comparison rows and inspect subtype, location and programme duration: RETAIL_FLAGSHIP, English district names and weeks remain visible.
findings.expected: Ordinary source labels and record types are natural Taiwan Traditional Chinese; internal field/enum/developer vocabulary does not appear in normal mode.
findings.observed: Normal Chinese exact locators expose the internal record types cost-line on historical source cards and forecast-cost-line on current forecast source cards. The corresponding financial authority badges and values remain correct.
acceptanceCriteria: QA-16: Natural Taiwan Traditional Chinese parity; no English developer/provider/policy plumbing in normal Chinese mode.
QA-18: Preserve accurate evidence and factor-panel behavior across required locales and viewports.
Retest every claim, source preview, calculation and factor panel in en and zh-TW at 1440x900, 768x1024, 390x844, 320x740 after repair.
findings.captureQualification: The accurately named actual-source and forecast-source images listed here were visually reviewed. Earlier forecast-table images that actually show source panels are retained but excluded from table proof; corrected table images have -visible suffixes.
findings.severityRationale: Reproducible bounded localization defect on the required Stage8 evidence path; the financial authority and value remain correct.
findings.remainingScope: Financial/source authority subchecks and per-viewport captures are recorded separately. This finding does not imply every panel has the same untranslated terms.

additionalFreshObservations.observed: Comparison summary displays internal policy identifier CPI-SIM-1.0 in normal zh-TW mode.
Normal Chinese comparison rows display RETAIL_FLAGSHIP, English district names and weeks.

The same untranslated normal locator class exposes quote-item on quoted-price source cards and supplier-offer on historical supplier-offer cards. Authority badges and historical/expired warnings remain distinct and correct.

findings.scopeClarification: Required opaque comparison/enrichment identifiers are provenance references explicitly required by QA-01, QA-03 and the canonical claims contract. Their exact bytes alone are not classified as this localization defect. Ordinary source-type labels, category/subtype names, units and policy presentation must still meet the normal-mode language requirement.

findings.title: Denied receipt dialog announces action creation even for a nonexistent action
findings.head: 3481dac48ec60e943b5d669f0f7ff0453756ab3d
steps: Issue a fresh active Viewer session and open the assigned Xinyi Project Actions route.
Open the known synthetic action receipt selector action_bf9f36bd-ba91-4095-acc2-9ca1532170f6.
Under that same active session, replace the selector with the nonexistent synthetic action_7c62492c-53bc-4ee6-94a2-913e6e679e22.
Repeat both URLs in zh-TW. Inspect the focused dialog heading, subtitle and unavailable body.
findings.expected: A denied or unavailable receipt should accurately present that state, without an affirmative action-created heading or a subtitle claiming a saved receipt. No sensitive payload or existence distinction is permitted.
findings.observed: Both known and nonexistent selectors show the same generic success heading (Internal review action created) and saved-receipt subtitle above an explicit localized unavailable message. Chinese has the equivalent affirmative heading/subtitle. No action-specific receipt payload is exposed, and both paired visible states are identical.
acceptanceCriteria: Retain the passing QA-07 non-disclosure and no-write invariants and indistinguishable missing/inaccessible responses.
Use a localized neutral unavailable/denied heading and description for unsuccessful receipt loads; reserve creation-success wording for an authorized successful receipt.
findings.criteriaQualification: The second criterion is a presentation correction derived from accurate outcome reporting; it does not imply a failed authorization or existence-hiding predicate. Whole-scenario acceptance impact is assessed separately.
findings.severityRationale: Bounded contradictory UI wording. Denial body and payload suppression remain correct, same-session pairs show no existence oracle, and this read-only journey creates nothing. No P0/P1 authorization or false durable receipt conclusion is supported.
findings.excludedComparison: The earlier active-Viewer versus revoked-Viewer comparison is invalid and contributes no finding evidence.
findings.scenarioAcceptanceImpact: Independent reviewer: this copy defect alone does not falsify QA-07/08 written non-disclosure, denial and missing/inaccessible-equivalence assertions. Track as an open P2 UX finding alongside successful applicable security checks; do not count these scenarios FAIL solely for this copy.

additionalFreshObservations.observed: The same success-heading/unavailable-body contradiction appears on same-session Northern foreign and missing action pairs in both locales. Denial equivalence and payload suppression still hold.

findings.head: 3481dac48ec60e943b5d669f0f7ff0453756ab3d
findings.title: Generic stale-confirmation error leaves focus on BODY with the error above the visible viewport
steps: As Mei, prepare a fresh Xinyi review from the canonical comparison; choose CHECK, VALIDATE_HISTORY, Iris Huang, due date2026-11-24 and acknowledge confirmation.
Preload en and zh-TW versions of the same proposal before the isolated authority mutation.
With the operator temporarily changing the required Nanjing imported-stone reference authority to OBSERVED, confirm the old form in each locale.
Before any manual scrolling or focus action, record activeElement, dialog membership and the alert bounding rectangle.
Scroll to the localized error only for the separately qualified screenshot; restore the authority mutation.
findings.expected: QA-15 requires the receipt heading or first error to receive focus. The generic stale error and recovery action should be discoverable and reachable within the review focus boundary.
findings.observed: Confirmation safely returns STALE_COMPARISON with no business write, but automatic focus is BODY outside the dialog in both locales. The error is above the viewport: zh-TW top=-1055.3046875,bottom=-918.4453125; en top=-1196.3046875,bottom=-1033.8515625. The complete draft remains present.
acceptanceCriteria: QA-15: receipt heading or first error receives focus.
After a generic stale/access/server error, place perceivable focus on the error or appropriate recovery heading inside the dialog and make the recovery action reachable.
findings.captureQualification: The screenshots were manually framed after the automatic-state measurements. They show error wording, not automatic error visibility or focus. The automaticFocus fields in qa11-authority-result.json are the evidence for the failure.
findings.severityRationale: Bounded reproducible focus defect. No severe keyboard trap or screen-reader announcement failure is inferred. Earlier native Tab containment and field-specific validation focus checks passed.
sourceCorroboration: src/components/internal-review/internal-review-sheet.tsx:87 invokes focusFirstReviewError when fieldErrors changes; generic stale failure has no field error.
src/modules/internal-review-experience/focus.ts:6 returns without moving focus when errors has no first key.

findings.head: 3481dac48ec60e943b5d669f0f7ff0453756ab3d
findings.title: A stored comparison remains inspectable without the mandatory stale warning after a required source authority change
findings.observedAtQualification: Window from recorded confirmation23:02:45Z through authority restoration23:04:25Z; exact source/claim capture timestamps are in their sidecars/browser observations.
steps: As Mei, open the stored canonical Xinyi comparison/enrichment and imported-stone forecast-versus-actual claim.

Prepare a fresh review and preload its English and Chinese forms. In the isolated synthetic database change only EvidenceReference evid_cost_cl_nanjing_023_v1_3 authorityState from RECONCILED_ACTUAL to OBSERVED. Preserve its observationType.
Confirm the previously prepared form in each locale: observe STALE_COMPARISON and no additional action, receipt, audit, consumption or evidence link.
Reopen the authorized Nanjing source in both locales: its current authority is exactly Observed in English and 已擷取 in zh-TW.
Reopen the stored imported-stone claim in zh-TW while the mutation remains active. Inspect the entire captured panel text, warning area and calculation.
Restore the exact pre-mutation source row and verify the normalized row hash and all business counts.
findings.expected: The historical comparison may remain inspectable, but must show the run stale status after a material evidence-authority change, while preventing new action creation. Historical values should not be silently presented as currently qualified evidence.
findings.observed: The confirmation guard correctly blocks the old form. The source preview shows the changed OBSERVED authority, yet the stored claim retains +18.4%, current forecast NT$2,360,000 and Nanjing historical contribution2,916.67 with eligibility wording and no stale-status qualification. No new computation, stale accepted write or automatic authority promotion was observed.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/design/EVIDENCE_PANEL_SPEC.md section21 Stale comparison: the panel remains inspectable but shows the run stale status and blocks new action creation.
docs/architecture/EVIDENCE_AND_AUTHORITY_MODEL.md section9 Comparison run: material source/policy/permission/active quote/forecast changes make the run stale.
computer-qa-plan.yaml severity P1 explicitly includes missing mandatory warning.
QA-11: stale or unsupported evidence never becomes authoritative; QA-18: prior deterministic evidence behavior remains intact.
sourceCorroboration: The current source is re-read while claim warningCodes remain stored; no current stale qualification was rendered in the observed panel.
findings.severityRationale: A mandatory stale warning is missing after a material required-source change. The explicit QA-plan P1 rule applies even though the confirmation write guard passes.
findings.localeQualification: Old-form rejection and changed source preview observed in en and zh-TW. The fully reopened stored claim panel proof is zh-TW; no English full-claim or other-viewport reproduction is claimed.
findings.captureQualification: The claim screenshot shows the upper claim and Nanjing calculation; the complete paired DOM text supports absence of a stale warning throughout the panel. The stored generation date does not qualify the current stale state.
findings.restoration: Exact normalized reference row SHA256 matched after restoration at2026-11-16T23:04:25.151Z; no new business write in this case.
findings.runDisposition: P1_STOP: no further scenario preparations, confirmations, negative POST requests, business journeys or fixture mutations. Safe read-only closure, revocation and publication continue.
